description: This Java class defines a security filter for processing JWT authentication tokens within the Thingsboard platform, extending Spring Security's AbstractAuthenticationProcessingFilter to handle token extraction, authentication attempts, and success/failure handling.

classes.name: JwtTokenAuthenticationProcessingFilter
classes.description: A security filter that processes JWT tokens for authentication, handling token extraction, authentication attempts, and setting security context upon success or failure.

methods.name: JwtTokenAuthenticationProcessingFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with failure handler, token extractor, and request matcher.

methods.name: attemptAuthentication
methods.description: Extracts JWT token from request and attempts authentication via the authentication manager.

methods.name: successfulAuthentication
methods.description: Sets the security context upon successful authentication and proceeds with the filter chain.

methods.name: requiresAuthentication
methods.description: Determines if the request requires authentication based on presence and prefix of the authorization header.

methods.name: unsuccessfulAuthentication
methods.description: Clears security context and triggers failure handler on authentication failure.
